sections.name: settings
sections.notes: All non-secret scalar fields plus nameserver, API allowlist, and UDP quick-port lists from the reference config are typed and editable. Filesystem paths, credentials, webhook and syslog targets, filename components, and rating keys use write-only replace/clear controls and remain redacted in draft responses. API key rotation is still metadata-only.

sections.name: debug
sections.notes: Global debug flags are typed. Per-module logging overrides are counted but remain unchanged until their module schema is available.

sections.name: address_objects
sections.notes: CIDR and FQDN address objects are represented by the typed object editor.

sections.name: port_objects
sections.notes: Port ranges are represented by the typed object editor.

sections.name: proto_objects
sections.notes: Protocol identifiers are represented by the typed object editor.

sections.name: detection_profiles
sections.notes: Common detection controls are typed; unknown future profile fields need a schema-backed fallback.

sections.name: captures
sections.notes: Capture posture is typed. Local paths, destination addresses, and interface names stay redacted and unchanged.

sections.name: content_profiles
sections.notes: Common content controls are typed; filters and rule payloads remain redacted.

sections.name: tls_ca
sections.notes: Only aggregate certificate-authority counts reach the browser; key and certificate paths remain server-side.

sections.name: tls_profiles
sections.notes: Core TLS controls are typed; SNI bypass material and unrecognized fields remain redacted.

sections.name: ssh_profiles
sections.notes: Authentication posture is typed; host-key paths and future channel policy fields remain redacted.

sections.name: alg_dns_profiles
sections.notes: The current DNS ALG profile schema is represented by the typed editor.

sections.name: routing
sections.notes: Current DNAT controls are typed; unknown future routing fields need a schema-backed fallback.

sections.name: policy
sections.notes: All fields currently returned by the policy snapshot contract are represented by the typed editor.

sections.name: starttls_signatures
sections.notes: Only aggregate counts reach the browser; expressions and flow definitions remain server-side.

sections.name: detection_signatures
sections.notes: Only aggregate counts reach the browser; expressions and flow definitions remain server-side.

sections.name: script_profiles
sections.notes: Runtime selection is typed; executable paths and script contents remain redacted.

sections.name: auth_profiles
sections.notes: Authentication posture is typed; identity mappings remain redacted.
